title: Ammeter reading
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and state the ammeter reading as 0.5 A.

title: Voltmeter reading
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and state the voltmeter reading as 3 V.

title: Capacitor charge
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and state the final charge on the capacitor as 4.5 × 10⁵ C.

title: Circuit simplification
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly simplify the circuit by identifying series and parallel combinations of the three 4 Ω resistors.

title: Equivalent resistance
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the equivalent resistance for the relevant part of the circuit for each sub-question.

title: Voltage division
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply voltage division to find the potential difference between points c and d.

title: Capacitor voltage
description: Important Criteria: The student must recognize that the stabilized voltage across the capacitor equals the open-circuit voltage between c and d.

title: Charge formula
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the formula Q = CV to calculate the capacitor charge.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should maintain consistent units throughout the calculation (Ω, V, A, F, C).

title: Short-circuit misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student treats the ammeter connection incorrectly (e.g., fails to recognize it creates a short between c and d).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student makes a sign error in current direction or voltage polarity.
